subject: Next steps: technical deep dive + VP/CTO intro to unblock procurement
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: James Wilson <james.wilson@orbitsys.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed next steps (tech deep dive + exec intro)

Hi James — great follow-up conversation earlier. Quick recap from our discovery call and suggested next steps to keep momentum: 

Recap (top points)
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency on customer-facing features while cutting per-token cost; target ~50% cost reduction relative to current setup.
- Data residency: Orbit needs EU-only storage for logs but inference can run in US/EU selectable pools.
- Peak profile: bursty traffic with 5–10x spikes during promotions; steady baseline ~200 concurrent requests.
- Security: procurement will want SOC 2 artifact checklist and network connectivity options.

Suggested next steps
1) Technical deep dive (90 min) with your ML infra/SRE and our Solutions Engineering team (Aisha) — demo of runtime, KV/prefix caching, and expected throughput/lossy quantization tradeoffs.
2) Executive alignment (20–30 min) intro: quick handshake between your VP/CTO and our Head of Solutions (Marissa) to unblock commercial/pricing decisions.
3) We’ll provide a concise one-pager for the CTO summarizing performance benchmarks + security controls before the exec call.

Proposed slots (PT) — please pick one that works for your team: 
- Tue Dec 1, 10:30–12:00 PT (deep dive) + Wed Dec 2, 09:00–09:30 PT (exec intro)
- Wed Dec 2, 14:00–15:30 PT (deep dive) + Thu Dec 3, 08:30–09:00 PT (exec intro)
- Thu Dec 3, 11:00–12:30 PT (deep dive) + Fri Dec 4, 09:30–10:00 PT (exec intro)

Attachments: short call notes, architecture diagram, and SOC2 evidence checklist stub attached for procurement.

Ask: James — can you confirm preferred deep-dive slot and whether Claire (CTO) would join the exec intro or if you prefer a VP-level attendee? Also please share the best procurement contact (email) so we can send the SOC2 checklist and a draft SOW timeline.

Thanks,
Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 (555) 212-7788

Connor — thanks for the clear recap and proposed flow. All of that tracks with what we discussed. A few notes: 

- Claire (CTO) asked to see the one-pager ahead of the executive intro; she prefers 15–20 minutes for the initial handshake.
- Procurement: procurement@orbitsys.com is copied — they’ll need the SOC2 checklist and preliminary pricing bands to start internal approval.
- Slot preference: let’s do Wed Dec 2, 14:00–15:30 PT for the deep dive. For the exec intro, Thu Dec 3, 08:30–09:00 PT works for Claire; she can join remotely for 20 minutes.

Quick context for the deep dive audience: our ML infra lead (Samir) and SRE manager (Denise) will join. They’ll want to focus on KV cache behavior for long-context requests and how failover looks across regions.

I’ll loop Denise and Samir directly once we lock timing.

Best,
James
